verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a custom-integration push/sync API section, with Integration Monitoring and OpenAPI fragments for the sync API. It also offers a GraphQL Developer API with introspection and a playground, plus ingestion webhooks that let external systems send data directly into Sprinto. However, the evidence never explicitly shows pushing evidence artifacts or control test results from uncovered systems. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that pushed data maps to evidence or control test results, a downloadable API spec (OpenAPI paths 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: the models page embeds OpenAPI fragments inside the docs page for the custom-integration sync API only
Webhooks allow external systems to send data directly into Sprinto. Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
You can use webhooks to: Receive incoming payloads, Trigger ingestion workflows, Process external events
You can use the playground to explore the API schema, test queries and mutations, and validate responses in real time.
